preconditions.description: Attacker must have some SAP tokens to create a valid permit signature
The contract must be deployed on multiple chains with the same DOMAIN_SEPARATOR
A victim must have approved spending allowance for the attacker on one chain

exploit_hint: The DOMAIN_SEPARATOR uses chainid() which is not included in the EIP-712 domain hash calculation. This allows permit signatures to be replayed across chains with the same contract address. First, obtain a valid permit signature from a victim on Chain A. Then replay the same signature on Chain B where the contract is also deployed. The permit() function will approve the attacker to spend the victim's tokens on Chain B without their consent, bypassing the nonce check since nonces are chain-specific.
